title: CRO Lead
description:
**The role in one line**


This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a


lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to


end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one


defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the


motions around it.

**Why this role exists**


Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build


pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who


does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the


research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they


think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page —


not a doc that someone else has to translate.

**What you'll own**

* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the


company's positioning evolves.

* Idea live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're


repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped


page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.

* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the


experiments, not just report the numbers.

* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a


visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.

* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions


around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't


done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.

**What you'll actually do, week to week**

* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out


what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a


template.

* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales,


what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page


should be.

* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing


is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.

* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get


from idea to a real, live example fast.

* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for


research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.

* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine


optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines


like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page


as "done" once it ships.

**What we need**

* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will


or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead


capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.

* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but


more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.

* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but


you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief


and push back on one.

* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical


concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer


actually understands.

* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write


content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines


(ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a


website role.

* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI


tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than


waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.

* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude


and similar) as part of daily work.

* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from


other teams.

* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct


exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.

**What's in it for you**

* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes.


Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the


copy, the page — is yours to run with.

* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory


here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get


rewarded for it.

* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of


Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not


busywork nobody reads.

**How we'll know this is working**


Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the


35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on


conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is


needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something


that's actively working for the business.

**Who you'll work with**


Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery


leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.

**Who you'll work with**


This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery


leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and creative Content Writer with at least 1 year of experience in writing high\-quality, engaging, and informative content. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding complex topics and converting them into clear, reader\-friendly content, especially for our Journal Website and Publication Platform.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

● Create, write, edit, and proofread content for: o Journal Website o Articles, blogs, research summaries, and publications o Website pages, FAQs, and documentation

● Develop academic, technical, and research\-oriented content for our journal platform.

● Coordinate with editorial, technical, and design teams to understand content requirements.

● Convert complex information into simple, structured, and easy\-to understand content.

● Ensure accuracy, originality, consistency, and clarity in all published content.

● Conduct in\-depth research and factchecking before publishing.

● Optimize content using basic SEO best practices (keywords, headings, meta descriptions). ● Maintain brand tone, editorial guidelines, and quality standards.

● Update and revise existing website and journal content as per new guidelines or updates. ● Assist in content planning and editorial calendars for the Journal Website.

**Knowledge Skills**

● Education: Master’s or any related field

● Experience: 1 Year

● Knowledge of legal, compliance, academic, or research\-based content is a plus **Proven experience as a Content Writer or similar role**  Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills **Ability to write well\-structured and properly formatted content**  Basic knowledge of SEO and keyword usage **Familiarity with MS Word, Google Docs, or CMS tools is a plus** 

**Attitude Others** 

● Adaptive to challenging environment.

● Proactive, results\-oriented and organized.

● Willingness to collaborate and coordinate with team members.

● Young and vibrant team

● Fast paced and growth minded culture

● Networking opportunity

● Professional growth and recognition

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
Technical Content / Documentation WriterJob Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Technical Content / Documentation Writer** to create clear, accurate, and user\-friendly technical content and documentation. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding complex technical concepts and converting them into easy\-to\-understand documentation for developers, customers, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and maintain **technical documentation, API documentation, user guides, and product documentation**.
* Write clear documentation for software products, features, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
* Convert complex technical concepts into simple and easy\-to\-understand content.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and subject\-matter experts to gather technical information.
* Create **API references, setup guides, integration guides, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and release notes**.
* Review and update existing documentation based on product and feature changes.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, well\-structured, and easy to navigate.
* Document technical processes, system workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Research technical topics and validate information before publishing.
* Maintain documentation standards, templates, terminology, and style guidelines.
* Assist in creating technical blogs, knowledge\-base articles, and product\-related content.
* Track documentation gaps and proactively improve the overall knowledge base.

Required Skills

* Excellent **English writing, editing, and proofreading** skills.
* Strong ability to understand and explain technical concepts.
* Experience creating software or IT\-related documentation.
* Basic understanding of **APIs, REST, JSON, databases, web applications, and software development workflows**.
* Ability to work with developers and technical teams.
* Strong research and information\-organization skills.
* Attention to detail and consistency.
* Familiarity with **Markdown, Google Docs, Microsoft Office**, or similar documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple documentation tasks and deadlines.

Good to Have

* Experience writing **API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI or Postman**.
* Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub and documentation version control.
* Familiarity with documentation platforms such as **Confluence, GitBook, Notion, or Docusaurus**.
* Basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, or other programming concepts.
* Experience writing developer\-focused blogs and technical tutorials.
* Familiarity with SEO and technical content optimization.
* Experience working with SaaS, APIs, cloud platforms, or developer tools.

Experience

**1–4 years** of experience in technical writing, software documentation, content writing, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A detail\-oriented technical writer who can work closely with engineering teams and transform technical information into **accurate, structured, and easy\-to\-understand documentation** that helps both developers and end users.

Pay: ₹10,148\.13 \- ₹35,244\.43 per month

Work Location: In person
